infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Allow ClioVision to connect to your Meta glasses.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Allow ClioVision to exchange camera and audio data with your Meta glasses.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Allow ClioVision to receive a camera image from your Meta glasses while identifying campus landmarks.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow ClioVision to receive a camera image from your Meta glasses for campus landmark identification.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow ClioVision to detect when you arrive at each campus tour stop.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Allow ClioVision to recognize Hey Clio and your campus question while the app is open.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow ClioVision to hear campus questions from your phone or connected glasses.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow ClioVision to detect when you arrive at each campus tour stop.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow ClioVision to protect your device session.
